overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The main issues were redundancy in the extracted lists for outputs (Q1), automatic metrics (Q2), and human evaluation guidelines (Q4). The paper clearly focuses on controllable text generation using a novel diffusion model, evaluated with both automatic metrics and human evaluation. No LLM-as-judge evaluation is present.
